duplicates.notes: Only the exact quarantined predecessor reuses the established URL slug. The distinct public aloo-paratha recipe retains its own route.

ingredients.notes: Eight measured items reviewed, including 150 g peeled raw potato, 60 g plain 3.9% yogurt and 12 g rapeseed oil. Wheat and milk are disclosed. The generated image shows the cut potato-filled flatbread and plain yogurt.

method.notes: Documented comparison covers 60% atta dough hydration, dough rest, fully cooked mashed potato, sealing the filling, rolling and griddle cooking. This version simplifies the seasoning and uses rapeseed oil.

food_safety.notes: The potatoes cook to fork-tender before mashing; both sides and the flour dough at the seam are cooked through before serving.

servings_and_time.notes: Two flatbreads, 30 g yogurt each. The 65 minutes cover preparation, 20-minute dough rest with potato cooking in parallel, rolling and sequential pan frying.

nutrition.notes: Fineli 111/922/205/535/620/30 and AFCD F003192/F003327 are bound to the current quantities. The fat estimate counts all oil and records 75% and 50% retention sensitivity. Fineli whole-wheat graham is the flour proxy. Potato leaching is unquantified.

glycemic.notes: New whole-wheat recipe and weighed yogurt have no source-matched glycemic-load approval. The quarantined predecessor and its historical study remain intact.
